content:
Apple is expanding the availability of watchOS 27.0.1 to more Apple Watch models this week, following last week's initial launch on Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4. Details below.

Apple Watch users can now install watchOS 27.0.1

Last week, Apple released watchOS 27.0.1 exclusively for Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4, fixing an issue that could cause some devices to unexpectedly restart.

Today, the company is pushing watchOS 27.0.1 to all other Apple Watch models compatible with watchOS 27, including:

  • Apple Watch SE 3
  • Apple Watch Series 9
  • Apple Watch Series 10
  • Apple Watch Series 11
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3

Apple has not changed the release notes for watchOS 27.0.1, which still read:

Similarly, the build number for today's release is also 24R365, the same as the version that launched last week on Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4.

In addition to watchOS 27.0.1, Apple this week also released iOS 27.0.1, iPadOS 27.0.1, visionOS 27.0.1, iOS 26.7.1, macOS 27.0.1 Golden Gate, macOS Tahoe 26.7.1, and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1.

While iOS 27.0.1 fixed an issue that could cause some iPhone 18 Pro models to restart when using Face ID, the other updates include additional bug fixes and security improvements.

Products worth noting on Amazon

  • Apple Watch Series 12
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4
  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods 5
  • AirTag (2nd generation) — 4-pack
  • MacBook Neo
  • Logitech MX Master 4
